    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractMessagePort
    Base implementation of MessagePort with common bookkeeping.
    Arithmetic
    COBOL arithmetic with GIVING, ROUNDED, and REMAINDER support.
    Arithmetic.DivideBuilder
    Builder for DIVIDE with optional REMAINDER.
    Arithmetic.GivingBuilder
    Builder for GIVING operations (ADD, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY).
    AtLeastOncePort
    At-least-once delivery — messages are acknowledged after processing.
    CicsCondition
    A CICS exceptional condition — thrown when a CICS command fails.
    CicsContext
    The CICS execution context — what a program sees during a transaction.
    CicsProgram
    A program that can be installed into a CICS region and dispatched to handle transactions.
    CicsRegion
    A CICS region — the running container that hosts programs, manages resources, and dispatches transactions.
    CobolConfig
    Configuration derived from COBOL's SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph in the ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
    CobolFile
    Abstraction over COBOL file I/O operations.
    CobolFile.IndexedFileBuilder
     
    CobolFile.OpenMode
    File open modes corresponding to COBOL's OPEN statement.
    CobolFile.SequentialFileBuilder
     
    CobolFile.StartCondition
     
    CobolProgram
    Top-level AST: a parsed COBOL program.
    CobolProgram.Condition88
    A level-88 condition name entry.
    CobolProgram.DataEntry
    A parsed DATA DIVISION entry (01-level through 88-level).
    CobolProgram.FileBinding
    A binding between an FD file name and its associated record.
    CobolProgram.Paragraph
    A paragraph in the PROCEDURE DIVISION.
    CobolRunner
    Command-line tool that transpiles, compiles, and runs COBOL programs.
    CobolSort
    COBOL SORT with INPUT PROCEDURE and OUTPUT PROCEDURE.
    CobolSort.SortInput
    Handle for the INPUT PROCEDURE — call CobolSort.SortInput.release() to feed the current sort record's contents into the sort.
    CobolSort.SortOutput
    Handle for the OUTPUT PROCEDURE — call CobolSort.SortOutput.returnRecord() to get the next sorted record.
    CobolSql
    COBOL embedded SQL semantics over JDBC.
    CobolString
    Fluent API for COBOL's STRING verb.
    CobolString.DelimiterSelector
    Fluent delimiter selector — returned by CobolString.from(Record, String).
    CobolUnstring
    Fluent API for COBOL's UNSTRING verb.
    CodecRegistry
    Central registry for field-level and record-level codecs.
    ColumnDef
    Definition of a SQL column derived from a COBOL field.
    Condition
    Represents a COBOL level-88 condition name.
    ConnectionFactory
    Factory for acquiring and releasing JDBC connections.
    CopybookImporter
    Imports COBOL copybooks (.cpy files) and produces cobol4j Record definitions.
    Decimal
    Immutable exact-decimal value — the safe numeric type for money and business math.
    Ebcdic
    EBCDIC/ASCII codec with full IBM code page translation tables.
    Ebcdic.CodePage
     
    ExactlyOncePort
    Exactly-once delivery — transactional messaging with no loss or duplication.

    Expression AST — structured representation of COBOL values and computations.
    Expr.BinaryOp
    Binary arithmetic operation.
    Expr.FieldRef
    A field reference — possibly subscripted or reference-modified.
    Expr.Figurative
    A figurative constant: SPACES, ZEROS, HIGH-VALUES, LOW-VALUES.
    Expr.FunctionCall
    A FUNCTION call: FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE, FUNCTION LENGTH(field), etc.
    Expr.Negate
    Unary negation.
    Expr.NumericLit
    A numeric literal.
    Expr.StringLit
    A string literal.
    Field
    A live reference to a field within a Record's byte buffer.
    FieldCodec<T>
    SPI for field-level data encoding/decoding within a Record's byte buffer.
    FieldDef
    Immutable definition of a single COBOL data item (field or group).
    FileOrganization
    COBOL file organizations.
    FileStatus
    COBOL FILE STATUS codes — the two-character status returned after every I/O operation.
    FireAndForgetPort
    Fire-and-forget messaging — best effort, no acknowledgement required.
    InMemoryMessagePort
    In-memory message port for testing and demonstration.
    Inspect
    Fluent API for COBOL's INSPECT verb.
    Intrinsic
    COBOL intrinsic functions.
    JavaEmitter
